verdict.rationale: Wrike is a work management platform. Reviewing AI-agent code diffs, commenting on specific lines, and having the agent iterate on code belongs to coding-agent and source-control tools, so this story is outside Wrike's product category. The evidence shows mobile apps, agents for task triage and execution, and GitHub sync, but nothing showing Wrike ships code review or code-generating agents that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
